scope: Minimal VM DOM adapter with fixed synthetic responses, not browser/API acceptance

results.name: mount is inert and never touches a session accessor
form proof stays in properties then clears without serialization
selection is explicit and requires another password
email input synchronously removes visible metadata and secret fields
same-document account event immediately clears visible results
storage event consumes no values and clears only on auth keys
cancel aborts own pending request and late ACK cannot repopulate DOM
pagehide discards proof and prepared metadata
late old response does not erase a new email proof
